title: University of Otago
description: The University of Otago's official brand guide defines the primary colours St Andrew's Blue (#060D87), Gold Rush (#F4B142), Black (#000000) and White (#FFFFFF), and the secondary colours Deep Blue (#000044), Deep Gold (#EE8A07), True Blue (#317BFF), True Yellow (#FFDE46), Sky (#DAEBFC) and Ivory (#FBF9ED).
